platform: Linux fixture persistence + transaction; no NTFS claim

tests.description: Durable generations survive a fresh session without resetting floors
Missing state cannot silently rebootstrap
Truncated newest record fails closed instead of loading an older floor
A gap in generation files is not treated as a fresh installation
Checksum corruption is detected before decoding state
Recomputed checksum cannot hide an in-chain trust-floor decrease
Each TUF/sequence/version/time floor refuses regression
Stale expected generation cannot overwrite a newer checkpoint
Duplicate fields, nulls and unknown state fields are refused
Oversized records and unknown ledger entries fail closed
Signed TUF cache survives a process restart and rejects older metadata
A cache with equal metadata version and different bytes is not a checkpoint
Clock rollback beyond five minutes suspends update
Five-minute boundary never lowers the persisted observation floor
Expiration is checked at the exact boundary
An initially valid target may expire before commit
Monotonic budget is enforced even with a frozen wall clock
Forward and backward jumps during a cycle are refused
Small backwards correction cannot extend target validity
A large persisted future clock blocks updates but not inspection of the confirmed bundle
Tolerance for clock rollback never revives a target expired at the observed floor
Cancel before confirmation writes no intent and approves no release
Intent and sequence floor are persisted before the selector changes
Candidate selection remains pending until a transaction-bound readiness fixture
Wrong transaction, nonce, digest and a reused readiness fixture are refused
Recovery restores only the recorded predecessor and keeps anti-replay floors
Completed recovery is idempotent and creates no retry loop
A newer sequence may proceed after recovery without reusing the failed transaction
A missing or corrupt backup bundle stops recovery without selecting another version
A valid selector outside the current transaction is refused
Selector installation ID, free path, duplicate and unknown fields are refused
Metadata expiry after durable intent prevents selector commit
Bundle content changed after preparation never reaches selector replacement
Incomplete journal at record-created blocks state fallback and preserves selector
Incomplete journal at record-written blocks state fallback and preserves selector
Incomplete journal at record-flushed blocks state fallback and preserves selector
Selector I/O failure leaves a recoverable durable intent
Kill a separate test process at begin:intent-persisted and reconcile in a new session
Kill a separate test process at begin:selector-replaced and reconcile in a new session
Kill a separate test process at begin:selected-persisted and reconcile in a new session
Kill a separate test process at recover:rollback-intent-persisted and reconcile in a new session
Kill a separate test process at recover:selector-replaced and reconcile in a new session
Kill a separate test process at recover:rollback-complete and reconcile in a new session
A second helper process cannot acquire the same installation lease
A crashed helper releases its kernel lease without deleting the lock file
Reopening and cleanup use the same installation lease
Missing lock file refuses participation instead of creating a second lock identity
